name: Professor
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.
wakes: Each night except the first, until the ability is used.
interaction: Shakes head or points to a dead player. Learns nothing directly; at dawn, after deaths, the Storyteller announces any resurrected player without saying why.
drunk_or_poisoned: No one is resurrected, and the ability is still spent.

rulings.text: Choosing an Outsider, Minion or Demon does nothing and still uses the ability.
A resurrected Townsfolk regains their ability, even a used once-per-game one; they wake later that night if they act after the Professor, and a first-night-only ability is used immediately.
Actual character counts: a Lunatic who believes they are the Tea Lady is not resurrected.
A drunk Professor's ability fails and cannot be used again.

test_scenarios.name: resurrect Townsfolk
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Professor, Bob Grandmother (dead), Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob is alive again (ALIVE reminder) and wakes immediately to learn his grandchild; at dawn the town learns Bob is alive. Alice gets NO ABILITY.

test_scenarios.name: non-Townsfolk wastes it
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Professor, Bob Lunatic believing Tea Lady (dead), Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: No resurrection; Alice gets NO ABILITY and is no longer woken.

test_scenarios.name: drunk Professor
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Professor drunk via Courtier, Carol Chef (dead), Dave Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Carol stays dead; Alice's ability is spent.

test_scenarios.name: decline
test_scenarios.expected: Nothing happens; Alice keeps her ability and is woken the next night.
